language-selector.description: You can modify the display language of CoFolio here. Translations may still evolve in the early versions.
language-selector.title: Change the interface language

profile-dropdown.description: Use the “Log out” action to log out of CoFolio.
profile-dropdown.title: Profile menu

modal.description: Would you like to learn about CoFolio's main features? Take a short guided tour to get started with the app.
modal.title: Discover CoFolio

draft-activities-widget.description: They are at the heart of learner support. They engage learners in work and reflection on their skills, life project, or other. You will be able to follow your learners through these activities. To see all activities, click on the link "See all my modified activities".
draft-activities-widget.title: Find here the latest activities you have or will have modified

feedbacks-widget.description: Find here the latest feedback requests sent by your learners. You can click on one of them to view it and respond to your learners. To display all requests, click on "See all my feedback requests"
feedbacks-widget.title: Find your latest feedback requests

nav-activities.description: Access two areas of the activity library. Your workspace: create, edit and view the activities you contribute to. All activities published in your institution: view the activities you contribute to, are responsible for learner tracking, or are a reader of.
nav-activities.title: Tab "ACTIVITY LIBRARY"

notifications-popover.description: You will be notified here of new notifications concerning, for example, feedback requests sent by your learners.
notifications-popover.title: Follow your notifications

published-activities-widget.description: To see all your published activities, click on the link "See all my modified activities".
published-activities-widget.title: Find here the latest activities you have or will have created and published

trigger-nav-student-tracking-menu.description: Find here the feedback requests sent by the learners you follow, for activities allowing feedback. You will be able to respond and keep a record of your responses. Requests for activity and skill assessments will also be available soon.
trigger-nav-student-tracking-menu.title: Menu "LEARNER TRACKING"

update-profile-button.description: Here, you can customize your profile with a photo, a cover image, and a short bio.
update-profile-button.title: Welcome to your CoFolio

library-activities-widget.description: Find here the latest activities available in your library, offered by your institution or by the national CoFolio team.
library-activities-widget.title: Find your recent activities

library-activities-widget-see-all-button.description: Use this access to find all the activities available in your library.
library-activities-widget-see-all-button.title: Access your entire activity library

nav-activities.description: Find the activities that allow you to work on your skills and your life project. Your library will be enriched over time with activities offered by your institution and by the national CoFolio team.
nav-activities.title: Tab "MY ACTIVITIES"

nav-skills.description: Find the skills worked on in your journey. You can complete them, reflect on their development, and associate traces, activities, experiences, or training to illustrate them.
nav-skills.title: Tab "MY SKILLS"

new-activities-widget.description: Find here the latest activities offered in the CoFolio catalog. When you register for an activity, it joins your library. Use the "See all activities" access to browse all the activities available in the CoFolio catalog.
new-activities-widget.title: Discover new activities

notifications-popover.description: Find here important information: responses to your feedback requests, requests addressed to you, and other actions to take.
notifications-popover.title: Follow your notifications

startTutoActivity.description: You are familiar with the main areas of CoFolio. Start your first discovery activity to add your first elements and get hands-on experience with your portfolio.
startTutoActivity.title: Now, put it into practice!

trigger-nav-life-project-menu.description: Find the sections that support you in building your journey and life project: better know yourself, showcase your experiences and training. In a future version, you will also be able to explore your futures and build your trajectories here.
trigger-nav-life-project-menu.title: Menu "MY LIFE PROJECT"

trigger-nav-tools-menu.description: Find here your transversal tools: your traces to keep your resources and your ready-to-use kits to showcase and export a selection of elements from your portfolio. Other tools will be added later.
trigger-nav-tools-menu.title: Menu "MY TOOLS"

traces-widget.description: Find here the latest traces added to CoFolio: files, online documents, videos, websites, or other resources. Use the "See all my traces" access to find all the traces deposited in your CoFolio.
traces-widget.title: Find your latest traces

update-profile-button.description: Start by customizing your profile with a photo, a cover image, and a short bio. You can reuse this information in your portfolio.
update-profile-button.title: Welcome to your CoFolio

ROLE_ACTIVITY_ADMIN.label: Activity admin
ROLE_ACTIVITY_ADMIN.description: Can manage all activities on the platform, including permanently deleting them.

ROLE_ACTIVITY_EDITOR.label: Activity editor
ROLE_ACTIVITY_EDITOR.description: Can create, edit, and delete unpublished activities.

ROLE_ADMIN.label: Establishment admin
ROLE_ADMIN.description: Can manage an establishment, its secondary establishments, its groups, and external users.

ROLE_CONFIG_MANAGER.label: Configuration manager
ROLE_CONFIG_MANAGER.description: Can manage the platform configuration and terms of use.

ROLE_ESTABLISHMENT_MANAGER.label: Establishment manager
ROLE_ESTABLISHMENT_MANAGER.description: Can manage primary and secondary establishments.

ROLE_ESTABLISHMENT_VIEWER.label: Establishment viewer
ROLE_ESTABLISHMENT_VIEWER.description: Can view primary and secondary establishments.

ROLE_EXTERNAL_USER_MANAGER.label: User manager
ROLE_EXTERNAL_USER_MANAGER.description: Can manage external users and their associations.

ROLE_GROUP_MANAGER.label: Group manager
ROLE_GROUP_MANAGER.description: Can manage groups, including importing groups.

ROLE_RBAC_ADMIN.label: RBAC admin
ROLE_RBAC_ADMIN.description: Can manage roles, their assignments, scopes, and authorization contexts.

ROLE_RBAC_AUDITOR.label: RBAC auditor
ROLE_RBAC_AUDITOR.description: Can view role and authorization administration data.

ROLE_STAFF.label: Staff
ROLE_STAFF.description: Has the necessary access for educational support, viewing accessible traces, and handling feedback requests.

ROLE_STAFF_ACTIVITY_AUTHOR.label: Activity author
ROLE_STAFF_ACTIVITY_AUTHOR.description: Can create, edit, and delete unpublished activities, duplicate activities, and edit published activities in an authorized context.

ROLE_STAFF_ACTIVITY_VIEWER.label: Activity viewer
ROLE_STAFF_ACTIVITY_VIEWER.description: Can view the activity catalog, their documents, and the staff library.

ROLE_STAFF_FEEDBACK_RESPONDER.label: Feedback responder
ROLE_STAFF_FEEDBACK_RESPONDER.description: Can view and handle feedback requests assigned to them.

ROLE_STAFF_FEEDBACK_SUPERVISOR.label: Feedback supervisor
ROLE_STAFF_FEEDBACK_SUPERVISOR.description: Can view feedback history and the dashboard of their establishment.

ROLE_STAFF_TRACE_REVIEWER.label: Trace reviewer
ROLE_STAFF_TRACE_REVIEWER.description: Can view and download learner traces accessible in an authorized context.

ROLE_STUDENT.label: Student
ROLE_STUDENT.description: Has a personal CoFolio space to build their life project and showcase their skills.

ROLE_STUDENT_ACTIVITY.label: Student activities
ROLE_STUDENT_ACTIVITY.description: Can view the activity catalog, enroll in activities, and access associated documents.

ROLE_STUDENT_EMPLOYMENT_KIT.label: Employment kit
ROLE_STUDENT_EMPLOYMENT_KIT.description: Can access their employment kit space and download multimedia content.

ROLE_STUDENT_FEEDBACK.label: Feedback request
ROLE_STUDENT_FEEDBACK.description: Can request feedback and view received feedback.

ROLE_STUDENT_PORTFOLIO.label: Student portfolio
ROLE_STUDENT_PORTFOLIO.description: Can manage their traces, activities, skills, experiences, education, and self-knowledge, as well as their associations.

ROLE_STUDENT_REFERENCE_DATA.label: Student reference data
ROLE_STUDENT_REFERENCE_DATA.description: Can view skill frameworks, external skills, and settings related to traces and complementary skills.

ROLE_SUPER_ADMIN.label: Super administrator
ROLE_SUPER_ADMIN.description: Has global administration rights on the CoFolio platform, including on establishments, activities, roles, configuration, and system operations.

ROLE_SYSTEM_OPERATOR.label: System operator
ROLE_SYSTEM_OPERATOR.description: Can perform sensitive system operations, including resetting and reinitializing database data.

ROLE_USER_BASE.label: Basic user
ROLE_USER_BASE.description: Can manage their own profile and view their notifications.
